'''''Kalanchoe'' × ''houghtonii''''' is a [[hybrid (biology)|hybrid]] between ''[[Kalanchoe daigremontiana]]'' and ''[[Kalanchoe delagoensis]]'' named after [[Arthur Duvernoix Houghton]]. It is often confused with ''Kalanchoe daigremontiana'' which has strongly cordate to [[auriculate]] or even [[peltate]] leaves, while the leaves of ''Kalanchoe'' × ''houghtonii'' are narrower and the leaf base is attenuate, cuneate to weakly cordate or auriculate.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Shaw|first=J.M.H.|date=2008|title=An investigation of the cultivated ''Kalanchoe daigremontiana'' group, with a checklist of ''Kalanchoe'' cultivars|url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/about-the-rhs/pdfs/publications/hanburyana/vol-3-june-2008/complete-version.pdf|journal=Hanburyana|volume=3|pages=17–79}}</ref> In hortuculture, it is often mislabelled as ''[[Kalanchoe serrata]]'', which is a different species.

There are four morphotypes (A, B, C, and D), and only Morphotype A is considered [[Invasive species|invasive]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Pascual-Díaz |first=Joan Pere |last2=Besolí |first2=Neus |last3=López-Pujol |first3=Jordi |last4=Nualart |first4=Neus |last5=Pérez-Lorenzo |first5=Iván |last6=Shtein |first6=Ronen |last7=Valenzuela |first7=Laura |last8=Garcia |first8=Sònia |last9=Vitales |first9=Daniel |date=2025-09-02 |title=The winner takes it all: a single genotype of ''Kalanchoe'' × ''houghtonii'' is a global invader |url=https://academic.oup.com/aob/article/136/1/179/8119321 |journal=Annals of Botany |volume=136 |issue=1 |page=179–198 |doi=10.1093/aob/mcaf076 |issn=0305-7364 |pmc=12401883 |pmid=40273308}}</ref> Morphotypes A, B, and C would finally transition to tricussate (alternative or ternately whorled) leaves like ''K. delagoensis'', while the leaves of Morphotype D remain decussate (opposite) like those of ''K. daigremontiana''.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Shtein |first=Ronen |last2=Smith |first2=Gideon F. |last3=Ikeda |first3=Jun |date=2021-11-09 |title=Aspects of the taxonomy of the ''Kalanchoe daigremontiana'' species complex (Crassulaceae subfam. Kalanchooideae) and associated interspecific hybrids in southern Madagascar, with the description of a new nothospecies, ''K.'' ×''descoingsii'' (=''K. laetivirens'' × ''K. tubiflora'') |url=https://phytotaxa.mapress.com/pt/article/view/phytotaxa.524.4.2 |journal=Phytotaxa |volume=524 |issue=4 |page=235–260 |doi=10.11646/phytotaxa.524.4.2 |issn=1179-3163}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Smith |first=Gideon F. |last2=Condy |first2=Gillian |date=2025 |title=''Kalanchoe'' ×''houghtonii'' |url=https://www.sanbi.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/2025-FPA-69.pdf |journal=Flowering Plants of Africa |volume=69 |pages=86–99}}</ref>
